accessible_via.return: _id, name, chr, start, end, strand, type, source_annotation, source, source_url

chr.description: Chromosome the element lies on, prefixed with 'chr'. Scaffolds and patch regions use UCSC-style names.

start.description: Start of the element, 0-based and inclusive.

end.description: End of the element, 0-based and exclusive.

strand.description: Strand the element is annotated on: + for forward, - for reverse, or . where strand does not apply.
